A_endgameResidual.what: Offline residual q = champion + f on the frozen section-68 PIMC rows (1,902,174 rows; slots 0-5 train, slot 6 validation). f zero-initialised; per decision: keep set y*-y<0.25 gets keepWeight*mean f^2, reject set a squared hinge (margin 0.125) below the weakest kept q; silent decisions mean f^2.
A_endgameResidual.keepWeightChoice: Chosen before any play on slot-6 validation labels by a rule fixed in advance (silent and keep-set agreement with the champion >= 0.98 / 0.95, then max informative hit): weights 1/10/30 gave silent agreement 0.895/0.980/0.992, keep-set 0.927/0.986/0.995, informative hit 0.821/0.808/0.807 (champion 0.805) -> 10. Development runs only, seed 3838120100.
A_endgameResidual.object: The single final export (fused ONNX c+f, champion I/O contract).
A_endgameResidual.primary: Held-out H1 (heldout-h1.json, 3,000 deals) each played twice with sides swapped: focal team champion until <= 20 cards then the residual student, opponents champion, greedy (evaluate.mjs --threshold=20). Positive evidence iff the 95% deal-cluster lower bound of focal mean signed round points per pair is > 0.
descriptive: Dev gate: 1,600 dev pairs (dev-gate.json), same design; reported, not required for H1.
Whole round: the fused student used for every decision (--threshold=108) on 400 dev pairs (dev-wholeround.json): non-inferiority check, point >= -0.02 expected.
Human endgame audit (section-67 protocol, student at <= 20 cards).

S_runtimeSearchArm.what: Node research-bot policy: at <= 20 cards the focal team plays the 8-world PIMC label argmax (exact solver 1.5M nodes / 3 s / 1M table per world, >= 4 worlds) with ties to the champion Q; champion elsewhere (evaluate.mjs --policy=pimc-search). Dev: +0.126 on 87 pairs, +0.097 [0.021,0.174] on 36 pairs.
S_runtimeSearchArm.primary: Held-out H2 (heldout-h2.json, 3,000 deals), same paired design; positive iff lower bound > 0. Positive would allow Node research bots (not the web) to use this search; no web change.
S_runtimeSearchArm.note: Not bit-reproducible (time budget per solve); values that finish are exact.
